description: Comprehensive legal ethics analysis engine covering ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct (all 8 categories), attorney-client privilege (Upjohn, crime-fraud exception), work product doctrine (Hickman v Taylor), conflicts of interest (concurrent/successive/imputed), client confidentiality (Model Rule 1.6), competence/diligence/communication, fees (reasonableness, contingency, fee-splitting), advertising/solicitation, unauthorized practice of law, multijurisdictional practice, lawyer discipline/sanctions, malpractice liability, fiduciary duties, trust account management (IOLTA), organization as client, diminished capacity clients, prosecutorial ethics (Brady obligations), judicial ethics (CJC), mediator ethics, arbitrator disclosure obligations, Texas Disciplinary Rules of Professional Conduct, Sarbanes-Oxley attorney reporting (SEC Part 205), legal tech ethics (AI-assisted practice, ghost-writing, metadata).

1_client_lawyer_relationship.description: Client-Lawyer Relationship: competence, scope, diligence, communication, fees, confidentiality, conflicts, duties to former clients, imputation, government officers, organizations, diminished capacity, safekeeping, declining representation, sale of practice, prospective clients

2_counselor.description: Counselor: advisor, evaluation for third persons, lawyer as third-party neutral

3_advocate.description: Advocate: meritorious claims, expediting litigation, candor toward tribunal, fairness, tribunal impartiality, trial publicity, lawyer as witness, prosecutorial duties, advocate in nonadjudicative proceedings

4_transactions_with_others.description: Transactions with Persons Other Than Clients: truthfulness, communicating with represented persons, communicating with unrepresented persons, respect for rights of third persons

5_law_firms_and_associations.description: Law Firms and Associations: responsibilities of partners/supervisors, subordinate lawyers, nonlawyer assistants, professional independence, multijurisdictional practice, restrictions on right to practice, law-related services

6_public_service.description: Public Service: voluntary pro bono, accepting appointments, legal services organizations, law reform activities, nonprofit/court-annexed legal services

7_information_about_legal_services.description: Information About Legal Services: communications concerning services, advertising, solicitation, communication of fields of practice, firm names/letterheads

8_maintaining_integrity.description: Maintaining the Integrity of the Profession: bar admission, judicial officials, reporting misconduct, misconduct, disciplinary authority (choice of law)

discipline_standards.aba_standards_for_imposing_sanctions: ABA Standards for Imposing Lawyer Sanctions (1992, amended 2021)
